body: 🤯 LobeHub is your Chief Agent Operator, organizing your agents into 7×24 operations by hiring, scheduling, and reporting on your entire AI team.
plain_description: LobeHub is your Chief Agent Operator — it hires, schedules, and reports on your entire AI team so you stay in charge without staying online. The big picture: treat agents as the unit of work, bringing all your AI teammates under one roof with shared context, personal memory, and scheduled runs. The bottom line: more productivity, fewer tools, and agents that learn from how you work.
technical_description: LobeHub is an open-source multi-agent orchestration platform that treats agents as the unit of work. It provides a full-stack architecture with a Next.js + Vite SPA frontend and a Hono-based server backend. The platform supports agent creation via an Agent Builder, agent groups for parallel collaboration, personal memory with structured white-box storage, scheduled task execution, and an IM Gateway for multi-platform messaging (Discord, Slack, Telegram, WeChat, etc.). It exposes a REST API and integrates with over 10,000 tools and MCP-compatible plugins. Deployment options include Docker, Vercel, Zeabur, Sealos, Alibaba Cloud, and bare metal.
title: LobeHub
